title: File:Turmeric Harvesting.jpg
description: A group of women sit on the ground and sort through a large pile of turmeric roots. They are cleaning the harvest by hand, picking out the good pieces and removing dirt. The roots are spread out in the sun to dry. As they move the heavy piles of turmeric, dust rises into the air around them. This is hard, manual work done to prepare the spice for the market
